exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.instructions: Bar on upper traps, brace core, descend until thighs are parallel or below, drive through heels to stand.

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.instructions: Bar resting on front delts with elbows high, squat to depth while keeping torso upright.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.instructions: Feet shoulder-width on platform, lower until knees are at 90 degrees, press back to start without locking out.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.instructions: Hold dumbbell at chest, squat deep keeping torso upright and elbows inside knees.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.instructions: Rear foot elevated on bench, lower front knee toward floor, drive back up through front heel.

exercises.name: Lunges
exercises.instructions: Step forward, lower back knee toward floor, push back to start; alternate legs.

exercises.name: Step-Up
exercises.instructions: Step onto a box with one foot, drive through that heel to bring the other foot up, step down with control.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.instructions: Back against pad, feet low and narrow on platform, lower until thighs are parallel, press back up.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.instructions: Seated, pad on shins just above ankles, extend legs fully then lower with control.

exercises.name: Cyclist Squat
exercises.instructions: Heels elevated on plates, narrow stance, squat deep with torso upright to maximise quad loading.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Hip hinge with soft knees, push hips back until you feel a strong hamstring stretch, drive hips forward to stand.

exercises.name: Conventional Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Bar over mid-foot, hip-width stance, hinge down and grip bar, brace and pull by pushing the floor away.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.instructions: Upper back on bench, bar across hips, drive hips to full extension squeezing glutes at top.

exercises.name: Good Morning
exercises.instructions: Bar on upper traps, hinge at hips with soft knees until torso is near parallel, return to upright.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
exercises.instructions: Facing away from cable, rope between legs, hinge forward then drive hips forward to stand tall.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Balance on one leg, hinge forward lowering dumbbell toward floor, keep hips square.

exercises.name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Legs nearly straight throughout, hinge to lower bar close to legs, focus on hamstring stretch.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Wide stance with toes turned out, grip inside legs, push floor away and lock out hips.

exercises.name: Flat Barbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Grip slightly wider than shoulder-width, lower bar to chest, press back to lockout.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Bench at 30-45 degrees, lower bar to upper chest, press up and slightly back.

exercises.name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Feet secured, bench declined, lower bar to lower chest and press back up.

exercises.name: Flat Dumbbell Press
exercises.instructions: Dumbbells at chest, press up and slightly inward, lower with control for full stretch.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.instructions: Bench at 30-45 degrees, press dumbbells from upper chest to lockout.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.instructions: Hands shoulder-width, body straight from head to heels, lower chest to floor and press back up.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.instructions: Adjust seat so handles align with mid-chest, press forward to near-lockout, return with control.

exercises.name: Cable Chest Fly
exercises.instructions: High cables, slight forward lean, bring handles together in a hugging arc, hold and return.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Chest Fly
exercises.instructions: Flat bench, slight elbow bend, lower dumbbells in arc until stretch felt, bring back together.

exercises.name: Pec Deck
exercises.instructions: Forearms on pads, squeeze arms together to centre, hold briefly, return with control.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
exercises.instructions: Hinge to near-parallel, row bar to lower chest driving elbows back, lower with control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.instructions: One hand and knee on bench, pull dumbbell to hip driving elbow back, lower fully.

exercises.name: Cable Row
exercises.instructions: Seated, feet on platform, row handle to abdomen driving elbows back, return to full stretch.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.instructions: Sit upright, use neutral grip handle, pull to lower sternum, squeeze shoulder blades, return slowly.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.instructions: Chest on incline bench, row dumbbells upward driving elbows wide, lower with control.

exercises.name: Meadows Row
exercises.instructions: Landmine setup, straddle bar facing end, row to hip with elbow flaring high.

exercises.name: Pendlay Row
exercises.instructions: Bar starts on floor each rep, torso parallel, explosively row to chest then lower to floor.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row
exercises.instructions: Straddle bar, grip handle, hinge torso forward, row to chest squeezing lats, lower fully.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press
exercises.instructions: Bar at upper chest, press overhead to lockout moving head back then through as bar clears, lower with control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions: Dumbbells at ear height, press overhead until arms nearly locked, lower back to start.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.instructions: Start with palms facing you, rotate outward as you press overhead, reverse on the way down.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions: Adjust seat so handles are at shoulder height, press overhead to near lockout, return slowly.

exercises.name: Push Press
exercises.instructions: Slight knee dip then explosively drive bar overhead using leg drive, catch at lockout.

exercises.name: Landmine Press
exercises.instructions: Hold end of landmine bar at shoulder, press upward and forward in an arc, return with control.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: Overhand grip slightly wider than shoulders, pull chest to bar driving elbows down, lower fully.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
exercises.instructions: Underhand shoulder-width grip, pull chin above bar, lower with control to full extension.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Grip bar wider than shoulders, pull to upper chest driving elbows toward hips, return to full stretch.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Very wide overhand grip, pull bar to upper chest, emphasise lat stretch at top.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Neutral close grip handle, pull to chest keeping elbows close to body, return to full extension.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: One arm, pull handle to shoulder driving elbow to hip, lean slightly away at bottom.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: Slight forward lean, raise dumbbells to shoulder height with elbows slightly bent, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: Cable at lowest setting, raise arm to shoulder height, lower with control under constant tension.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.instructions: Rope at forehead height, pull to face splitting the rope, rotate external at end, return slow.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly
exercises.instructions: Hinged forward, raise dumbbells in wide arc to shoulder height leading with elbows, lower with control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Front Raise
exercises.instructions: Raise one dumbbell in front to shoulder height with slight elbow bend, lower with control.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
exercises.instructions: Facing the pad, grip handles, pull arms back in wide arc squeezing rear delts, return slowly.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Underhand grip shoulder-width, curl bar to chin keeping elbows fixed, lower fully.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Supinate as you curl each dumbbell to shoulder, lower with control.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.instructions: Neutral grip (palms facing each other), curl dumbbell to shoulder, lower fully.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
exercises.instructions: Upper arm on preacher pad, curl bar up, do not swing, lower until elbows nearly straight.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
exercises.instructions: Low cable, underhand bar, curl to chin keeping elbows fixed, return under constant tension.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Seated on incline bench, arms hang behind body for full stretch, curl up supinating wrist.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown
exercises.instructions: High cable, elbows tucked to sides, push bar/rope down to full extension, return to 90 degrees.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.instructions: Rope behind head, elbows pointing up, extend arms overhead, lower rope behind head.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher
exercises.instructions: Flat bench, arms vertical, lower bar toward forehead by bending elbows, press back to start.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Shoulder-width or slightly narrower grip, lower bar to chest keeping elbows close, press up.

exercises.name: Triceps Dips
exercises.instructions: Upright torso on parallel bars, lower until elbows at 90 degrees, press back to lockout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Kickback
exercises.instructions: Hinged forward, upper arm parallel to floor, extend forearm back to lockout, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
exercises.instructions: Face down, pad just above heels, curl toward glutes, hold briefly, lower fully.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.instructions: Seated, pad on top of lower legs, curl down toward floor, return to full extension.

exercises.name: Standing Leg Curl
exercises.instructions: One leg, curl heel toward glute against resistance, control the descent.

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
exercises.instructions: Ankles secured, fall forward slowly under hamstring control, push up with hands at bottom.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.instructions: Balls of feet on platform, rise to full extension, hold, lower to full stretch.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.instructions: Knees under pad, raise heels to full extension, lower to full stretch, focus on soleus.

exercises.name: Donkey Calf Raise
exercises.instructions: Hinged at hip, weight on lower back, raise heels to full extension, lower to full stretch.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions: Forearms on floor, body straight, brace hard, hold position without sagging hips.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.instructions: Kneel facing cable, rope behind neck, crunch elbows to knees rounding the spine, return.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.instructions: Hang from bar, raise legs to parallel or higher with control, lower without swinging.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.instructions: Knees on floor, wheel in hands, roll forward keeping hips low, pull back using abs.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.instructions: On back, arms up, knees 90 degrees, lower opposite arm and leg toward floor while pressing low back down.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction Machine
exercises.instructions: Seated, pads on outer knees, push knees apart against resistance, return with control.

exercises.name: Cable Kickback
exercises.instructions: Ankle cuff on low cable, slight forward lean, kick leg straight back squeezing glute at top.

exercises.name: Donkey Kickback
exercises.instructions: On hands and knees, drive one heel toward ceiling squeezing glute at top, lower with control.
